notes.title: Version 1.01 online!
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

- New menu with “Options” to set volumes, custom controls (such as WASD movement) and “always run”
- Better icon
- Fixed the tree graphic glitch and the ropes in Ignis’ house
- Cocktail body doesn’t bring up “inventory” options after discovering murder weapon
- The “device” can’t be used again after completion
Thank you Simone for your feedback!
- Minor bug fixes

Thank you for playing!
